atmo.text: Which gas is the most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
atmo.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of air; oxygen about 21%.

polpo.text: How many hearts does an octopus have?
polpo.explanation: Three: two branchial hearts and one systemic heart.

anemo.explanation: An anemometer measures wind speed; wind direction is read from a wind vane.

nobel.text: Which scientist won Nobel Prizes in two different scientific fields?
nobel.explanation: Marie Curie: Physics in 1903, Chemistry in 1911.
